# EduLog v2.0.0-alpha.9

Teaching owners can create physical classrooms and scheduled classes again. Attendance follows the teacher assignments effective on each lesson date. Retrying a previous request preserves a later attendance edit. Leave and closures temporarily change the displayed status while retaining the original entry.

Classes retain multi-lesson report progress, including makeup lessons. Teachers can add an eligible trial report by hand. Classroom and account security now show translated inline messages.

Back up the database and apply all pending migrations in order through `1000176_trial_manual_reports.sql`. Deploy the frontend, API and Presidio images tagged `2.0.0-alpha.9`. Follow the [OAuth deployment guide](../../docs/deployment/auth-oauth-mail.md) for provider settings, callbacks and manual linking.
